reran: cmd.sh on w4-int: 'Tree has erroneous type: ex.value()' at fields, program prints List(Some(a), None). w3-base and 2.13.18: same plus NullPointerExceptions in the checker; program still runs.
user_impact: Only -Ycheck users on a generic method with a non-local return; no effect on the bytecode.
fixability: clear cut: build the NonLocalReturnControl handler in UnCurry.nonLocalReturnTry from the rhs's (skolemized) result type rather than meth.tpe_.finalResultType. Checker-visible types only.
links: Belongs with retronym/scala#509, whose third part deals with skolems from the original typing in the checker.
note: The 'needs a second look' is resolved: -uniqid -Vprint:uncurry shows the parameter p typed with the skolem B#6891 and the handler's NonLocalReturnControl[Option[B#6890]] with the type parameter B#6890, so the handler is ill-typed against the skolemized body. A real (harmless) tree inconsistency made by uncurry, not a checker bug.
